title: docs(changeset): correct the `SpinnerSchema` member attribution in the 5632 pending body
body:
Fixes #9753

`Clause-②: no` — prose in one pending changeset body; no declaration face moves, no accepted set is relaxed.

## What lands

One sentence in `.changeset/5632-svg-host-dom-passthrough.md` is **corrected outright**. Frontmatter untouched (`check-changeset-overwrite`'s documented **case 2**).

The claim was **BORN FALSE**, ⛔ not ROTTED, so it takes the opposite repair: no dating, no "this was true at…" preamble, no falsifier note — because nothing falsified it. It was wrong at the ref that wrote it.

## Which commit wrote the lines — established here, ⛔ not inherited from the card

Two independent instruments, both run in this worktree against the real history:

```
$ git log -L 10,12:.changeset/5632-svg-host-dom-passthrough.md --oneline
e304a4ef7 fix(components): route the SVG-hosted renderers' spread through `toDomProps` (#7564)
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.changeset/5632-svg-host-dom-passthrough.md
@@ -0,0 +10,3 @@
```

```
$ git blame -L 10,12 origin/main -- .changeset/5632-svg-host-dom-passthrough.md
e304a4ef76 (Leehom 2026-09-03 22:17:03 +0000 10) …
e304a4ef76 (Leehom 2026-09-03 22:17:03 +0000 11) …
e304a4ef76 (Leehom 2026-09-03 22:17:03 +0000 12) …
```

`log -L` shows the hunk as an ADD against `/dev/null` — the commit that wrote the lines is the commit that created the file, and it is the only entry in the whole `log -L` walk, so nothing has touched those lines since. ⇒ write-time ref = **`e304a4ef7`**, confirmed, not assumed.

## `SpinnerSchema`, read at both refs

**At the write-time ref** — `git show e304a4ef7:packages/types/src/feedback.ts`, `SpinnerSchema`:

```ts
export interface SpinnerSchema extends BaseSchema {
  type: 'spinner';
  /** Spinner size @default 'md' */
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';
}
```

⇒ no `icon`, no `color`. The sentence was false the moment it landed.

**On `origin/main`** — `git show origin/main:packages/types/src/feedback.ts`, same symbol: the same `type` + `size`, plus `body?: never` and `children?: never` (the objectui#9256 / ADR-0049 refuse-by-name pair). ⇒ still no `icon`, still no `color`. Nothing moved under the sentence; it never described this interface.

## What actually went wrong — verified independently of the card

`IconSchema` is declared in `packages/types/src/layout.ts`; `SpinnerSchema` in `packages/types/src/feedback.ts`. At `e304a4ef7`, `IconSchema` declares `icon: string`, `size?: number`, `color?: string`. ⇒ the `icon` / `color` half belongs to `IconSchema` **alone**.

⭐ The decisive evidence is inside `e304a4ef7` itself: the **same commit** wrote both renderers' pass-through docblocks, and each of them is correct **per interface** —

- `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/icon.tsx`: *"`IconSchema` declares exactly `icon`, `size` and `color`, and this renderer already CONSUMES all three by name"*
- `packages/components/src/renderers/feedback/spinner.tsx`: *"`SpinnerSchema` declares exactly one key beyond the SDUI base, `size`, and this renderer already CONSUMES it by name through `sizeClasses`"*

⇒ the changeset body collapsed those two per-interface statements into one and applied the `icon` side to both. That is the lane's standing **「a name is not a key — a key is (interface, name)」** error one level up: a claim naming two interfaces while describing one.

## The replacement

```diff
-`icon="check"` on all 71 icon nodes in the schema catalog. `IconSchema` and
-`SpinnerSchema` declare only `icon` / `size` / `color`, and both renderers
-already consume all three by name, so the SDUI pass-through list withholds
-nothing they need.
+`icon="check"` on all 71 icon nodes in the schema catalog. The two nodes declare
+different keys, and each renderer consumes its own node's keys by name:
+`IconSchema` (`packages/types/src/layout.ts`) against the pass-through docblock
+in `renderers/basic/icon.tsx`, and `SpinnerSchema`
+(`packages/types/src/feedback.ts`) against the one in
+`renderers/feedback/spinner.tsx`. `icon` and `color` are `IconSchema`'s alone —
+`SpinnerSchema` declares neither. Read those two declarations for what they
+carry; this paragraph deliberately copies no member list. So the SDUI
+pass-through list withholds nothing they need.
```

⛔ **No member list is written down.** Per Commandment #9, the replacement names **where each declaration is derived** — file plus symbol — so a reader re-takes the reading instead of trusting a figure that will rot. No line addresses, so Commandment #11 has nothing to catch either.

⛔ **The surrounding conclusion is NOT assessed.** "the SDUI pass-through list withholds nothing they need" is preserved verbatim and deliberately left to stand; it is out of this card's scope.

## Frontmatter untouched — mechanically

`check-changeset-overwrite` prints both sides itself:

```
      M  .changeset/5632-svg-host-dom-passthrough.md
             declared at base: @object-ui/components: patch
             declares now:     @object-ui/components: patch
```

## Before/after probe — wrap-tolerant, with a lit control and an absent control

⭐ Changeset prose wraps near eighty columns, so a line-anchored `grep -F` is **structurally blind** to the sentence. Demonstrated on this very corpus:

```
$ grep -cF '`IconSchema` and `SpinnerSchema` declare only `icon` / `size` / `color`' BEFORE_FILE  -> 0
$ grep -cF '`IconSchema` and `SpinnerSchema` declare only `icon` / `size` / `color`' AFTER_FILE   -> 0
```

0→0 on a sentence that demonstrably changed ⇒ broken instrument, ⛔ not an absent change. The working probe flattens whitespace before counting (`re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)`), over `git show HEAD~1:PATH` vs the working file:

| needle | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SUBJECT-OLD — the false claim | **1** | **0** |
| SUBJECT-NEW — the correction | **0** | **1** |
| LIT CONTROL — unchanged sentence that spans a wrap | 1 | 1 |
| LIT CONTROL 2 — the preserved conclusion, spans a wrap | 1 | 1 |
| ABSENT CONTROL — `DATED READING`, never present | 0 | 0 |

The two lit controls span a line wrap and read 1 on both sides, which is what proves the instrument sees across the wrap; the absent control reads 0 on both sides, which is what proves it is not matching everything.

## Changeset grade — MEASURED, ⛔ not asserted by analogy

Both legs run `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` on **this same corpus** (this working tree vs its merge base):

- **Absent control** — this change as it stands. `EXIT=0`: *"1 file(s) changed, 0 of them published source of a package the release covers … ✅ No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed."*
- **Lit control** — a marker line appended to `packages/types/src/feedback.ts` (published source of `@object-ui/types`). `EXIT=1`: *"2 file(s) changed, 1 of them published source of a package the release covers … ❌ 1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change adds no changeset: @object-ui/types / packages/types/src/feedback.ts"*.

⇒ the grade is **no changeset owed**, on an instrument shown to be able to say otherwise.

The mutation was proved to land on disk before the leg was read (`grep -cF` marker 0→1, and `git hash-object` returning `bc911354e…` against the HEAD blob `6c8e6083d…`), the restore leg ran under `trap … EXIT INT TERM` using an absolute `$REPO_ROOT` path and `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`, and the restore is proved by state rather than by an exit code: `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty, and `git hash-object packages/types/src/feedback.ts` back to `6c8e6083d026ba18d999341f241c9058086ab2c7`, byte-identical to `git rev-parse HEAD:packages/types/src/feedback.ts`.

## The window

Release PR #5400 was re-read immediately before this push and is **open, `merged=false`** — so the repair lands in the pending body, which is this dispatch's only sanctioned channel. ⛔ #5400 is not touched by this branch, and no file it owns is touched. #5400 is not addressed here.
